entities.summary: Pete de Freitas (b. 1961-08-02, Port of Spain) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Port of Spain and United Kingdom. Known in the fields of united kingdom, composers & musicians, europe.
